theme_central: Nothing was created in vain, and nothing is hidden from Allah: from duty toward parents to the destruction of the people of 'Ad, down to the jinn themselves recognizing the truth of the Qur'an.
sources_note: Precisely sourced division (slideshare.net, Al Quran Chapter 46): 1-3, 4-8, 9-14, 15, 21-26, 29-30, 32-35.

branches.title: Creation with truth, powerlessness of the idols
branches.resume: Everything created with truth for a fixed term; what they invoke besides Allah has no power at all.

children.t: Everything created with truth, for a fixed term
Total powerlessness of what they invoke besides Allah

branches.title: The Prophet, ancient message confirmed
branches.resume: Muhammad is not a messenger of a new kind; the Qur'an in agreement with the Torah given to Musa.

children.t: Ancient message confirmed, agreement with the Torah, knowledge of the unseen reserved for Allah

branches.title: Kindness to parents
branches.resume: Pregnancy and weaning, gratitude toward parents; ranks according to deeds, fleeting enjoyment of this world reproached.

children.t: Kindness to parents, pregnancy and weaning over 30 months
Ranks according to deeds, fleeting enjoyment of this world reproached

branches.title: 'Ad, the region of al-Ahqaf
branches.resume: Source of the surah's name: the people of 'Ad warned by Hud, rejection, destruction by the wind.

children.t: The people of 'Ad in the region of al-Ahqaf, warned by Hud, destroyed by the wind
Ancient cities destroyed, their false deities powerless to help them

branches.title: The jinn and the Qur'an
branches.resume: A group of jinn listen to the Qur'an, believe in it, and return to preach among their people.

children.t: Jinn listen to the Qur'an, believe, become preachers among their own

branches.title: Closing
branches.resume: Allah able to resurrect the dead; final patience asked of the Prophet.

children.t: Allah able to resurrect the dead, final patience requested
